business_process: Consulting RSO services and program audits
description: Scheduled visits to client licensees and x-ray registrants; annual radiation protection program audits; audit reports and corrective action letters
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Audit reports are due within 30 days of each visit under client contracts; client inspections are scheduled weeks ahead; about $2,000 of consulting revenue is billed per business day
manual_workaround: Paper audit checklists and field notes; visits continue; reports issued when systems return
dependent_people_or_facilities: Principal Health Physicist; 2 Senior Health Physicists; Health Physicist

description: Draft and revise security plans and implementing procedures for the 6 category 2 clients; annual security program reviews (37.55) and access authorization program reviews (37.33); review reports
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Confidentiality drives the rating: disclosure of a client's security plan or approved-individual list breaches the client contract and the client's 37.43(d) duty, and would likely end the Part 37 service line (15% of revenue). Availability is less urgent: reviews have an annual window
manual_workaround: Work from the client's on-site copies under the client's procedures; reschedule review visits within the annual window
dependent_systems: SYS-01 (restricted client library after remediation); SYS-04
dependent_third_parties: Productivity suite vendor; MSP; the 6 Part 37 clients
dependent_people_or_facilities: Principal Health Physicist; Senior Health Physicist (Part 37 services lead); other client-approved staff only

description: Calibrate portable survey meters against the Cs-137 beam calibrator; record readings; issue calibration certificates; ship instruments back
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Clients need calibrated survey instruments to work: medical licensees must calibrate before first use, annually, and after repairs (10 CFR 35.61), and all licensees must calibrate periodically (10 CFR 20.1501(c)). The practice promises a 5-business-day turnaround and keeps 12 loaner meters. Readings recorded since the last SYS-02 entry would have to be redone
manual_workaround: Record readings on paper data sheets and issue certificates when SYS-02 returns; ship loaner meters to clients with overdue instruments
dependent_third_parties: Calibration and leak test system vendor; MSP; calibrator manufacturer (service); parcel carriers

description: Receive leak test wipe samples from customers; count them on the gamma spectroscopy system; report results; tell the customer at once if a sample exceeds the leakage limit
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Wipe samples are stable and can wait several days; customers' tests are due at fixed intervals, and a leaking source must be found quickly so the customer can act
manual_workaround: Hold samples in order of receipt; count urgent samples first after restoration; phone urgent results and confirm in writing
dependent_third_parties: Gamma spectroscopy software vendor; calibration and leak test system vendor; MSP

description: Shielding calculations for x-ray, CT, and nuclear medicine rooms; acceptance and periodic radiation surveys; survey reports
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Project deadlines are set weeks ahead; calculation files can be rebuilt from client drawings
manual_workaround: Calculations on a clean laptop from client drawings; survey data on paper forms

description: Supplemental health physics staff at 2 power plants during refueling outages (ALARA planning, dose assessment, survey review); about 4 to 6 weeks a year in total
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: During an outage the plant expects staff on every shift; missed shifts cost contract revenue (about $3,000 a day) and the reactor relationships. The practice's own systems matter little on site: staff work on plant systems and may not connect practice devices
manual_workaround: Staff work entirely on plant-provided systems; coordinate by phone; carry no practice media into the plant until it is confirmed clean
dependent_systems: SYS-01 (email and schedules); SYS-04 (laptops kept outside the plant)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Senior Health Physicist (field services lead); 1 to 2 other consultants per outage

description: Email, phone, and calendar for all clients; scheduling; delivery of reports and certificates; contract notices to clients
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every other function depends on email and the client file library; contract clocks (4 hours to reactor clients, 24 hours to Part 37 clients) need working phones and contact lists. The nightly backup sets the RPO for restored mail and files
manual_workaround: Office line forwarded to the owner's mobile phone; printed client contact list; send urgent documents from a clean device after the suite returns
dependent_third_parties: Productivity suite vendor; MSP; phone carrier; internet provider

description: Invoices and receivables; biweekly payroll through the payroll service; HR records; vendor payments
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A cash reserve covers about 45 days of expenses; payroll runs biweekly
manual_workaround: Payroll service repeats the prior payroll; invoices issued late
dependent_third_parties: Accounting and payroll service vendor; bank

business_process: Radiation safety program for the practice's own license
description: Source inventory and security, periodic leak tests of the practice's own sealed sources, staff dosimetry, license records and reports to the State
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: License records and the source inventory must be available to the State at inspection; physical source security does not depend on IT (locked calibrator and cabinet in an alarmed suite)
manual_workaround: Paper source log in the calibration room; dosimetry processor phone line for dose reports
dependent_systems: SYS-02; SYS-01; SYS-08 (outside the SSP boundary)
dependent_third_parties: Calibration and leak test system vendor; dosimetry processor
dependent_people_or_facilities: Principal Health Physicist (RSO); Calibration Laboratory Technician
